interest: These cross-reference sheets illustrate how U.S. diplomatic personnel in Hong Kong monitored the precarious neutrality of Portuguese Macau and expanding Japanese military operations in South China in early 1941. They highlight the strategic vulnerability of Macau following Japanese military landings on the adjacent Kwangtung coast and record direct American intelligence gathering through Consul Ward's on-site visit to the colony. The records also provide valuable insight into State Department filing and cross-referencing practices, connecting records on Portuguese colonial administration (853e.00) with intelligence files on Japanese military activities and espionage (894.20253E).
overview: This file (894.20253E, File 1252) consists of two State Department cross-reference sheets dating from February and March 1941 concerning Japanese military activities, espionage, and movements around the Portuguese colony of Macau. Both documents originated from the American Consulate General in Hong Kong under Consul General Addison E. Southard and point to underlying records filed under Portuguese colonial affairs (853e.00/10 and 853e.00/11). The indexed materials include a February 1941 report on Japanese activities in Macau and Despatch No. 859 of March 15, 1941, which examined the impact of Japanese military landings along the Kwangtung coast on Macau and enclosed a memorandum by Consul Ward detailing his visit to the colony.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a February 20, 1941 report from Hong Kong regarding Japanese activities in Macau.
subfiles.summary: This confidential cross-reference sheet notes a report dated February 20, 1941, dispatched from Hong Kong by Consul General Addison E. Southard regarding Japanese activities in Macau. The original document was filed under 853e.00/10, relating to internal affairs in Portuguese Macau. The reference is classified under decimal number 894.20256E/4 within the State Department's files on Japanese military activities.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet: Report on Japanese Activities in Macau

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing Despatch No. 859 from Hong Kong concerning the effect of Japanese landings on the Kwangtung coast on the colony of Macao.
subfiles.summary: This cross-reference note indexes Despatch No. 859 dated March 15, 1941, sent from Hong Kong to the Department of State. The underlying despatch evaluates the repercussions on the Portuguese colony of Macao following Japanese troop landings along the Kwangtung coast and transmits a memorandum of a visit by Consul Ward to the colony. The primary paper was placed in file 853e.00/11 and cross-indexed under 894.20253E/5.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet: Despatch No. 859 on Effect on Macao of Japanese Landing on Kwangtung Coast
